title: Frequency Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the oscillation frequency using f = c/λ, yielding 1.5×10⁹ Hz.

title: Pulse Interval Identification
description: Important: Recognizes that the time between consecutive pulses is 1/n, not the pulse duration t.

title: Travel Time Calculation
description: Important: Correctly subtracts the pulse duration from the pulse interval to find the available travel time for unambiguous ranging.

title: Maximum Distance Formula
description: Essential: Applies the correct formula for maximum unambiguous range: s_max = c * (1/n - t) / 2, yielding 30 km.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities (λ, t) to consistent SI units before calculation.

title: Ignoring Pulse Duration
description: Pitfall: Uses the full pulse interval (1/n) as the travel time without subtracting the pulse duration t.

title: Forgetting Factor of 2
description: Pitfall: Calculates the one-way travel distance but fails to divide by 2 for the round-trip radar signal.
